title: 第2608章 屠天行找上门第2607章 血灵宗的追杀
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
离开血灵星矿后，楚云五人一路疾驰，准备先找一处隐蔽之地躲避血灵宗的追杀。
飞行片刻后，李星云看着楚云问道：“楚云，我们现在去哪里？”
楚云正要说话，腰间的一块传音玉牌突然亮了起来。
嗡！
只见传音玉牌微微震动，散发出淡淡的白光。
楚云目光一凝，连忙将传音玉牌取下，放在耳边。
很快，里面便传来姬腾焦急的声音。
“楚云，你快回来！”
“有个叫屠天行的人，自称是七杀星域星主。
他带着不少人来到姬家堡，让我们交出上清宫的人。”
“他说如果不交人，就灭了我们姬家堡！”
听到这话，楚云脸色瞬间阴沉下来。
“屠天行？”
李星云见楚云神情不对，连忙问道：“怎么了？”
楚云收起传音玉牌，眼中露出冰冷之色。
“屠天行带着七杀星域的人，去姬家堡了。”
“他让姬腾交出梦青璃，不然就灭掉姬家堡。”
“什么？”
李星云闻言，脸色顿时一变。
陆朝阳、苏千娇和赵元元同样皱起眉头。

赵元元沉声道：“屠天行不是七杀星域的星主吗？他怎么会追到南域来？”
楚云神色凝重，道：“他之前一直在追杀梦青璃。”
“我本来以为梦青璃逃到南域后，他不会再继续追来。”
“没想到此人为了杀梦青璃，居然不惜跨越星域，直接找到姬家堡。”
李星云皱眉道：“此人可是七杀星域的星主，就算天域宫愿意帮我们，恐怕也未必能让他退走。”
楚云目光闪动，沉声道：“不管他会不会退，天域宫这块牌子都得先用上。”
说话间，他再次催动传音玉牌。
“姬腾，你立刻通知天域宫的人。”
“让他们暂时稳住屠天行，尽量不要和对方发生冲突。”
“我们马上赶回去。”
传音玉牌里面，很快传来姬腾的声音。
“好，我这就去通知他们。”
说完，传音玉牌上面的光芒渐渐消失。
李星云看着楚云，沉默少许后，缓缓说道：“楚云，要不……我们把梦青璃交给他吧？”
“此人既然能成为七杀星域之主，实力绝对不简单。”
“而且之前连梦青璃都不是他的对手，我们更不可能是他的对手。”
陆朝阳三人闻言，都没有说话。
他们知道李星云这么说，并不是害怕屠天行，而是不想让楚云为了梦青璃，招惹一名难以抗衡的强敌。
楚云闻言，却冷笑一声。
“交给他？”

“梦青璃既然已经归顺我，那就是我神龙殿的人。”
“我的人，岂能让别人随便欺负？”
李星云脸色凝重，道：“可是对方不是血灵宗那种势力。”
“血灵宗最强之人，也只是星主境修为。”
“但屠天行是七杀星域之主，他的实力恐怕比我们想象的还要强。”
content_en:
After leaving the Blood Spirit Star Mine, Chu Yun and the other two galloped all the way, preparing to find a hiding place to avoid the pursuit of the Blood Spirit Sect.
After flying for a while, Li Xingyun looked at Chu Yun and asked, "Chu Yun, where are we going now?"
Just as Chu Yun was about to speak, a sound transmission jade plaque on his waist suddenly lit up.
Buzz!
I saw the sound transmission jade tablet vibrating slightly and emitting a faint white light.
Chu Yun's eyes narrowed, and he quickly took off the sound transmission jade tablet and put it to his ear.
Soon, Ji Teng's anxious voice came from inside.
"Chu Yun, come back quickly!"
“There is a man named Tu Tianxing, who claims to be the Star Master of the Seven Kills Star Territory.
He brought many people to Jijiabao and asked us to hand over the people from Shangqing Palace. "
"He said that if he doesn't surrender, he will destroy our Jijiabao!"
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun's face instantly darkened.
"Tu Tianxing?"
Li Xingyun saw that Chu Yun looked wrong and asked quickly: "What's wrong?"
Chu Yun put away the sound transmission jade token, with a cold look in his eyes.
"Tu Tianxing took the people from the Seven Kills Star Region to Jijiabao."
"He asked Ji Teng to hand over Meng Qingli, otherwise he would destroy Jijia Fort."
"What?"
When Li Xingyun heard this, his expression suddenly changed.
Lu Chaoyang, Su Qianjiao and Zhao Yuanyuan also frowned.
Zhao Yuanyuan said in a deep voice: "Isn't Tu Tianxing the star master of the Seven Kills Star Territory? How could he pursue him to the Southern Territory?"
Chu Yun looked solemn and said, "He has been chasing Meng Qingli before."
"I originally thought that after Meng Qingli escaped to the Southern Territory, he would not continue to pursue her."
"I didn't expect that in order to kill Meng Qingli, this person would go across the star field and directly find Jijiabao."
Li Xingyun frowned and said: "This person is the Star Master of the Seven Kills Star Territory. Even if the Tianyu Palace is willing to help us, I am afraid that we may not be able to make him retreat."
Chu Yun's eyes flashed and he said in a deep voice: "Whether he will retreat or not, the Tianyu Palace brand must be used first."
As he spoke, he activated the sound transmission jade tablet again.
"Ji Teng, please inform the people in Tianyu Palace immediately."
"Let them stabilize Tu Tianxing temporarily and try not to conflict with the other party."
"We'll rush back right away."
Ji Teng's voice soon came from the sound jade tablet.
"Okay, I'll go and notify them right away."
After saying that, the light on the jade tablet gradually disappeared.
Li Xingyun looked at Chu Yun, and after a moment of silence, he slowly said: "Chu Yun, how about... let's hand Meng Qingli over to him?"
"Since this person can become the Lord of the Seven Kills Star Territory, his strength is definitely not simple."
"And even Meng Qingli was not his opponent before, and we are even less likely to be his opponent."
When Lu Chaoyang and the other three heard this, they didn't speak.
They knew that Li Xingyun said this not because he was afraid of Tu Tianxing, but because he didn't want Chu Yun to provoke a powerful enemy who was difficult to contend with for Meng Qingli.
When Chu Yun heard this, he sneered.
"Leave it to him?"
"Since Meng Qingli has surrendered to me, she is a member of my Divine Dragon Palace."
"How can I let others bully my people?"
Li Xingyun looked solemn and said, "But the other party is not a force like the Blood Spirit Sect."
"The strongest person in the Blood Spirit Sect is only at the Star Lord level."
"But Tu Tianxing is the master of the Seven Kills Star Territory, and his strength may be stronger than we imagined."
